description: Two live owners on adjacent rows 1 and 2. In each phase process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; process b updates V of row 2 (errors recorded), explicitly in its own transaction (phases 1-4) or with no transaction (phases 5-6); the transactions resolve in the given order (A/B owner, C commit, R rollback): 'A:C B:C', 'B:C A:C', 'B:C A:R', 'A:R B:C', then b implicit with 'A:R' and 'A:C'. After each phase both processes read rows 1, 2 and 64 and row 1 of U.
